Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc decreased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 21.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc sold 10,725 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The institutional investor held 39,000 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.07 million, down from 49,725 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bridgecreek Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $59.60 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.89% or $0.74 during the last trading session, reaching $82.06. About 2.09 million shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
